prompt: Describe the dispatch/reporting procedure only; do not dispatch or write files. Two independent read-only reviewers have complete exact router decisions. The user has not requested routing details. Explain what must exist before approval or dispatch, what goes in chat, where submitted and executed settings and completion results belong, and what to record when execution metadata is unavailable.
expected_output: Record complete decisions before approval or dispatch and append submitted settings, runtime observations and results to one session artifact outside maintained source. Announce roles and scope concisely without raw YAML. Apply exact settings; preserve runtime limits, approval boundaries and unconfirmed execution metadata.
assertions: One session artifact contains routing decisions and all dispatch/results metadata.
Chat names roles and scope; raw routing/audit data requires a user request.
Exact submitted values, approval boundaries and runtime controls remain enforced.
